name: calmduty
description: CalmDuty (calmduty.com) — Local-first, zero-data-retention Hybrid AI operations inbox for the agent era (Web SPA + Cloud Run relay).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for gemini-decision-1 (0 output tokens), gemini-3.5-flash-lite streaming chat, and gemini-4-neon tool synthesis (all called with store: false).

EDGEOPS_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32-byte secret key used for AES-256-GCM envelope encryption of stored read-only Slack OAuth tokens.

SLACK_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Slack App Client ID for 1-click Read-Only Slack OAuth.

SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional Slack App Client Secret for 1-click Read-Only Slack OAuth.
